scope: Independent static source delivery review of FZ-001..006 and FZ-008

findings.problem: Historical generator is mode 0644; original reproduction driver requires executable input.
findings.resolution: Build wrapper creates a separate executable exact-SHA scratch copy before invoking the original driver. Historical bytes and mode remain preserved.

findings.problem: Original compiler can continue after translation unit failures; wrapper must reject partial output even when link returns zero.
findings.resolution: Wrapper checks exactly one positive complete compilation count and successful link.

limitations: No native full build was performed in this review; all seven declarations still state incomplete full dependency closure.

FZ-008 is the historical intentional SSLSockets compatibility fallback; its bytes equal the delivered FZ-007 T7d override, whose new full build reproduces classes.dex but not historical ZIP bytes.
